# Session-share preflight fixtures (NOT-514)

Reproducible inputs for `npm run test:session-share-preflight`
(`tests/test-session-share-preflight.js`). Moved here in NOT-650 from the
former per-ticket evidence directory so the preflight keeps reading them
while historical run output leaves the tree.

- `identity-matrix.json` — the machine-readable client/lifecycle matrix
  (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor × six lifecycle cases): classification,
  ambient behavior, and the exact-or-fail-closed `share_current` outcome
  per case, plus the minted-context binding. Probed 2026-10-24 at HEAD
  `8e19aa24e51aeb4a26bf4d9a057ae2012daadc3b`. The test asserts its shape,
  its classifications, and that it holds no raw id, credential, or path.
- `probe-results.md` — the redacted probe procedure and results behind
  the matrix (what the probes keep, the commands, per-client result
  tables). The test asserts it holds no user path, raw UUID, or
  credential.

Neither file is regenerated by the test; both are frozen inputs. New probe
runs go to CI artifacts or release attachments, not git.
